name: Service utilization margin builder
why: Turns a month of paid hours into utilisation, revenue and delivery margin for a service team, the core of the job and service costing skill for agencies and consultancies.

name: Per-order profit calculator
why: Works out profit per order after every cost and the break-even, the same build-up the product margin skill uses for online sellers.

name: Discount and price change checker
why: Checks a planned sale or price change against margin, matching the discount break-even step in the product margin skill.

name: Landed cost allocator
why: Spreads freight, duty and supplier invoices into a true landed cost per unit, the first input to any product margin.

name: Restaurant portion cost builder
why: Costs a dish per portion from real weights and prices, a worked example of unit costing for food businesses.

name: Manufacturing yield cost bridge
why: Shows the true cost per good unit after yield loss and scrap, for makers whose standard cost ignores waste.

name: Monthly budget versus actual keeper
why: Runs the monthly comparison of spend against budget with reasons, a light version of the budget against actuals skill.

name: Explain a department budget overrun
why: Builds a reconciled variance report and options for one budget owner, useful when one line in the management pack needs a deeper look.

name: Build a monthly P&L and know your real margin
why: Takes invoices and sales to true unit costs and a monthly profit and loss, a starting point for owners with no management pack yet.

name: Check supplier invoices before approval
why: Matches supplier invoices before payment, one of the cheap controls the money controls review recommends against duplicate and diverted payments.

name: Recurring invoice exception review assistant
why: Keeps a list of recurring invoice exceptions with evidence and an approval list, supporting the monthly controls spot check.

name: Grant restrictions cash reconciler
why: Splits bank cash into restricted grant money and free cash, the check behind the nonprofit board finance report.

name: Prepare a grant spending evidence pack
why: Produces a reconciled grant spending table and evidence gaps for a funder, the follow-on to the grant tracker in the nonprofit prompt.
